subject: Deployment readiness checklist & evidence request — POC next steps
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Deployment readiness checklist & evidence request — POC next steps

Hi Liam — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can size the POC and recommend the right hosting path (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private).

Summary of what I heard during the call:
- Primary constraint: customer-managed encryption keys (HSM-backed) and strict key custody requirements.
- Identity: Okta SSO + SCIM for provisioning; SAML metadata exchange required.
- Logging: 7+ years retention required; ability to export logs to their SIEM (Splunk) and to show audit trails for model calls.
- Network: VPC peering or private link; egress IPs must be allowlisted.
- Data residency: all inference logs and customer data must remain in us-east-1.

Action items / evidence we need from Cydon to finalize recommendation:
1) SSO: Okta org URL, SP metadata or certificate, SCIM provisioning scope — we can accept either IdP-initiated/ SP-initiated flows.
2) KMS/HSM: legal requirement summary on key ownership (BYOK required? HSM mandatory?), and any FIPS/Level details.
3) Logging: confirmation of 7-year retention and whether aggregated/anonymized logs are acceptable; sample retention policy doc or compliance excerpt.
4) Network: list of CIDR ranges and whether peering or NAT + egress allowlist is preferred.
5) PO/Procurement timeline & any required security questionnaires (we can prioritize SOC2 + encryption evidence).

Attached: POC-reqs.xlsx (fillable checklist), redwood-sso-kms-evidence-template.docx (template we use to collect artifacts).

Why this matters for hosting recommendation:
- If BYOK + HSM with strict custody is mandatory and Cydon needs on-prem key control, Private (VPC/on-prem) or our Private deployment will be the only viable path.
- If they can accept Redwood-managed KMS with HSM-backed keys and long-term log export, Dedicated could meet the needs with additional contractual SLAs.
- Hosted API is only realistic if key custody and retention constraints can be satisfied via managed integrations — otherwise we should recommend Private/Dedicated.

Please confirm the items above (1–4) and the procurement timeline so we can produce a one-page runbook and a delta cost estimate. Proposed next step: 30-minute tech deep-dive Wed/Thu (I can loop in infra eng).

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman

From: Liam O'Rourke <liam@cydonhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T15:31:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Deployment readiness checklist & evidence request — POC next steps

Naomi — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming the key points and answering your asks below.

1) SSO: We use Okta (org: cydon.okta.com). We'll provide SP metadata and SCIM credentials; we require SCIM provisioning for service accounts.
2) KMS/HSM: BYOK is required for production. We have an HSM fleet (Thales/HSM) and cannot hand over key material. For the POC we can do a limited BYOK test vector, but production must have customer-controlled keys. FIPS 140-2 Level 2+ is an internal requirement.
3) Logging: We require 7-year retention and export to our Splunk instance (https://splunk.cydon.local). Logs must include request audit (timestamp, requestor, model version). Aggregation is acceptable for long-term storage but raw audit trails must be available on request.
4) Network: We prefer VPC peering in us-east-1. We will provide allowlisted CIDRs.
5) Procurement: Targeting PO in Q1 2027; security review started — we can move faster if you provide artifact templates and a clear matrix showing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private tradeoffs.

Latency question: For real-time care triage we need p99 inference < 400ms for 512-token requests; is that achievable on Dedicated/Private? If not, please note expected deltas.

I'll attach our internal compliance excerpt and loop in procurement in a follow-up.

—Liam
Director of Product Ops | Cydon Health
liam@cydonhealth.com
